To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we proposed a method to estimate the equivalent circuit parameters and established a harmonic model of the electric vehicle charging station based on the measured data of the ac side of the charging station.

the proposed parameter estimation method can effectively estimate the equivalent circuit parameters and the proposed equivalent circuit can effectively model the harmonic characteristics of charging stations with three-phase uncontrolled chargers.

the proposed parameter estimation method can effectively estimate the parameters of the harmonic model of a three-phase electric vehicle charger with a high degree of accuracy, that the proposed harmonic model can effectively estimate the harmonic components of the ac side voltage and current of the charging station, and that the harmonic model can be used to predict the harmonic components of charging stations with the same configuration.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the harmonic modeling of charging stations and the parameter sensitivity analysis of equivalent circuits.
a method for estimating the harmonic model parameters of a charging station and the establishment of the equivalent circuit of the charging station based on the measured data.
the measurement-based harmonic modeling of electric vehicle chargings, which is a key step for harmonic mitigation of the electric vehicle charging station.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper proposes an equivalent circuit model and a parameter estimation method for the three-phase uncontrolled electric vehicle charger with a passive power factor corrector.
the proposed parameter estimation method and harmonic analytical model can provide a reliable reference for the harmonic pollution analysis of electric vehicle chargings stations.
the proposed method can be used as an efficient and effective tool in evaluating the harmonic distortion of charging stations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this paper presents a method for estimating the parameters of the equivalent circuit of the electric vehicle charging station and a harmonic model of the electric vehicle charger, which can provide a theoretical basis for the analysis and prediction of harmonic pollution of the charging station and for the design and optimization of the harmonic filter.
the proposed parameter estimation method and equivalent circuit modeling method could be applied to other electric vehicle charger models.
the proposed harmonic model can be used to predict the harmonic distortion at the charging station and to provide guidance for the design of harmonic filters.

the proposed method can be used to estimate the parameters of the charging stations and to build a harmonic analytical model of charging stations.

the proposed parameter estimation method is effective in estimating the parameters of the harmonic model and that the equivalent harmonic model of the three-phase uncontrolled charging station is accurate.
the equivalent circuit parameters are sensitive to the harmonic components of charging current and that the equivalent circuit can be accurately modeled based on the measured data.
